record.question: Which statement is correct about inflation?
options: Headline inflation is the raw inflation reported through WPI
Core inflation is the inflation reported through CPI
Core inflation excludes food and fuel items from headline
CPI is the sum of wholesale price index and index of industrial production
record.explanation: Core inflation excludes food and fuel items from headline inflation.
